notes: Heartbeat-owned bridge for TASK-2026-0005 real sovereign Base activation.
Consumes only already-materialized StegVerse-002/micro-node-runtime source and credential-free local endpoint/process descriptors.
Child execution receives a minimal reconstructed environment; parent GitHub/provider/wallet credential variables are not inherited.
A validation-only reference endpoint, credential-bearing descriptor, missing local source, unsynchronized endpoint or failed proof returns BLOCKED rather than success.
Writes only receipts/sovereign-base-rpc-activation/** and grants no TVC route admission, trade, wallet, signing, broadcast or settlement authority.
No Render, Vercel, Cloudflare hosted runtime, GitHub token/runtime or third-party scheduler is a production dependency.
Portable resident bundles may supply micro-node-runtime through STEGVERSE_MICRO_NODE_RUNTIME_ROOT or the canonical repository-root map; no Git metadata or network checkout is required.
